Heavy Rainfall Causes Flooding in Indian Cities

Heavy rainfall has caused flooding and deaths in several Indian cities, including Surat, Guwahati, and Gurugram. The government has taken measures to prevent waterlogging and block drains to mitigate the effects of heavy rainfall. However, critics argue that human interference is a major cause of flooding, rather than just rainfall alone.
